title: How Sensei Fits Together
look: Architecture board: dashed boundaries for your machine, the models and the team, with the app, gateway, dōjō and phone as paper boxes on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, vermillion for inference, jade for the team. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: The whole picture
scenes.desc: The simplified architecture assembles: your machine, the models it can use, your team, your phone.

scenes.name: On your machine
scenes.desc: The desktop app wraps the CLI, the MCP servers, an always-on daemon and a local Postgres; your assistant connects to it.

scenes.name: The gateway
scenes.desc: One inference entry point inside the app: embedded Ollama by default, your own Ollama host or cloud keys when you want them, with fallback.

scenes.name: The dōjō
scenes.desc: Your team's service: lessons go up, consolidated practice comes back down; an opt-in public collective sits beside it.

scenes.name: Relay
scenes.desc: The phone companion: watch runs, approve gated actions, answer decisions; only status and choices cross.

scenes.name: Sensei and dōjō
scenes.desc: What each one does: Sensei works the code on your machine; the dōjō shares what the team learns.

scenes.name: Together
scenes.desc: The loop: Sensei learns, you share, the dōjō consolidates, upgrades come back, Sensei applies them.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: your machine does the work, your team keeps the lessons.
